none: PAS ESS-1B508F: Fragment of copper alloy roman finger ring with SSS on bezel.
contea di ritrovamento: Central Bedfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Fragment of copper alloy Roman finger ring, dating to the 3rd century AD. The bezel and part of the band are all that remain. The band is oval in shape and raised above the band. The band flares towards the bezel. The letters SSS are engraved upon the bezel. The ring has a mid green patina. The ring appears to be of Guiraud's type 3 group.
